summary: Frontend-only verification of Paper Hoof homepage: intro scroll-reveal paragraph, single Featured Work project, removal of 'Recent Projects' heading. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: IntroReveal: scroll handler correctly uses rAF throttling and cleans up listeners. Good.

RecentProjects: navigation slug derived from featured.name via lowercase/space-replace — works for 'Burger Hot' -> 'burger-hot' but is brittle for names with punctuation. Consider using a stable slug field on the project data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 acceptance points verified via Playwright at 1440x900: (1) DOM order intro-reveal precedes #recent-projects; (2) full sentence present, per-word opacity scales monotonically with scroll: near-opaque count = 0 -> 6 -> 13 -> 20 -> 24 at scroll progresses 0/0.25/0.5/0.75/0.95 through the 220vh section — confirms scrubbing behavior; (3) exactly 1 project-card rendered (project-card-1 'Burger Hot'), badge text 'FEATURED WORK' positioned top=16px right=16px inside .featured-media (top-right confirmed), rp-tags [BRANDING, IDENTITY, UI/UX] top-left; (4) 'Recent Projects' string not present anywhere in body text; (5) click navigates to /work/burger-hot; (6) hero-scroll-arrow, navbar-work-link (visible on scroll), footer all render; zero page/console errors.
